Irrigation & Waterways Dept, Govt of Rajasthan 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Rajasthan · IN 
 
 No. CC/39/2011/010 
 Dated: 31/03/2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 This is to certify that the work of "Sewerage Network - Rajasthan Pkg-10" (sewerage drainage),
 awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) ,
 has been completed in all respects on 03/05/2011 at a gross executed value of Rs. 2348.00 Lakh
 (Rupees 23.48 Crore Only). 
 
 The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and
 contract conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection carried
 out by the undersigned. 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Sanjay Joshi. This certificate is issued for record
 and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past
 performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Irrigation & Waterways Dept, Govt of Rajasthan
